records.title: Base cbXRP/USDC 62.5% LLTV market page
records.summary: Captured market fields: $59.13M outstanding loans, $23.01M total liquidity, $82.14M market size, displayed 90.49% utilization, 62.5% LLTV, 12.67% liquidation penalty, Chainlink XRP/USD oracle at $1.25055, 7.90% instantaneous borrow rate, 7.95% seven-day average, 7.17% lend rate, zero displayed bad debt, and recent Base activity through 04:09 UTC. Page pagination indicates 1,198 borrower rows and 164 supplier rows. The market is permissionless and has multiple vault suppliers; Coinbase-originated share is undisclosed.
records.limitations: Displayed liquidity/borrow/market-size fields do not reconcile with displayed utilization if interpreted as free liquidity. Oracle 'value secured' has unclear scope. Capture is a UI snapshot, not a normalized API response; exclude derived utilization and oracle-secured value pending reconciliation.

records.title: Crypto-backed borrowing and XRP collateral product page
records.summary: Coinbase describes USDC loans powered by Morpho, collateral moving on-chain to Morpho, USDC proceeds deposited into the Coinbase account, and a listed maximum of $100,000 against XRP. Coinbase is the product interface; the underlying Morpho market is permissionless.
records.limitations: The page's generic 86% liquidation example is BTC-specific and must not be applied to XRP. Coinbase does not disclose what share of the public cbXRP/USDC market originates through its interface, aggregate XRP loan volume, or liquidator disposition.

records.title: cbXRP proof of reserves
records.summary: The page reports 151,405,263.6 XRP held in 20 XRPL reserve addresses against 151,403,016.069 cbXRP in circulation, approximately 100.00148% coverage and a 2,247.531 XRP surplus.
records.limitations: Snapshot is as of the displayed October 30 refresh, not the current run time. The reserve addresses may overlap with third-party Coinbase exchange-wallet aggregates; do not count backing XRP and cbXRP supply as two separate economic assets.

records.title: Labeled exchange-wallet balances and changes
records.summary: Provider reports 22.37B XRP across 701 labeled wallets at 24 exchanges; same-wallet-set balance change was -234.9M XRP over seven days. Major labels include Upbit 6.43B, Coinbase 5.84B, Binance 2.58B and SBI VC Trade 59.5M XRP. Coinbase reserve XRP is included in or may overlap the Coinbase label.
records.limitations: Wallet labels and cold/hot classifications are third-party attribution. Balances include cold storage and are not tradable float, customer liabilities, beneficial ownership or net spot demand. New/unlabeled wallets and label changes can distort flows.

records.title: XRP supply, escrow, RWA, stablecoin and XRPL activity dashboard
records.summary: Provider reports 31.40B XRP in escrow, a November 1 gross unlock of up to 1B XRP, 4.33B tracked XRPL RWA value with 276M distributed/transferable and 4.06B registry value, approximately 954.3M RLUSD on XRPL, and tracked exchange/DeFi balances. It distinguishes registry representations from transferable tokens.
records.limitations: Single-provider dashboard; escrow relocking is historical behavior, not a guarantee. RWA registry values are not freely transferable capital. Stablecoin supply and transaction counts do not prove XRP purchases. Verify issuer balances and ledger state independently.

records.title: USDC supply on the XRP Ledger
records.summary: Current dashboard snapshot reports approximately $4.47M native USDC on XRPL, around 0.01% of global USDC supply, with roughly $4.5M total displayed.
records.limitations: Third-party token-supply dashboard; not Circle's official per-chain attestation. Verify issuer/currency account balances directly before using as a production feature.

records.title: Public REST API documentation
records.summary: Documents public GET endpoints for market discovery, state and rate/APY history, with filters such as chain, loan token, collateral token and listed status. Useful for scheduled point-in-time market snapshots.
records.limitations: REST coverage does not provide a complete historical position ledger, all liquidation events, arbitrary date ranges or a full oracle/beneficial-owner map. Supplement with Base logs, contract state and independent price/oracle sources.

records.title: XRP derivatives and liquidation heatmap panel
records.summary: Captured panel showed XRP near $1.2503, aggregated open interest near $2.82B and 24-hour volume near $2.24B. Displayed liquidation heatmap levels are modelled from open interest and leverage assumptions.
records.limitations: Heatmap levels are modelled potential liquidation zones, not observed resting orders or guaranteed liquidation prices. Venue universe and notional basis require reconciliation.

records.title: XRP derivatives, funding and liquidation panel
records.summary: Captured panel showed XRP near $1.26, open interest near $1.32B, 24-hour liquidations around $3.2M, average funding around +0.0072% per eight hours, Binance funding around +0.0100%, and Binance long-account share around 72.9%.
records.limitations: Open interest differs from Alpha by about 2.14x within eight minutes. Account share is not notional exposure. Provider independence and contract-universe equivalence are not established; exclude OI composite until reconciled.

records.title: Now Available: USDC on the XRPL
records.summary: Circle announced native USDC on XRPL mainnet, with Circle Mint and Circle APIs supporting the asset without a third-party bridge. Circle identifies the issuer/currency pair and institutional mint/redeem path.
records.limitations: Launch availability does not establish current liquidity depth, active holders, net external capital or XRP buy pressure.

records.title: USDC product, reserve and network support disclosures
records.summary: Circle lists 38 natively supported networks including XRPL, Base and Arc; describes 1:1 redemption, cash/cash-equivalent reserves, Circle Reserve Fund managed by BlackRock and monthly third-party assurance. Circle's dynamic transparency page did not expose a stable per-chain numerical table in the captured HTML.
records.limitations: Issuer claims are primary evidence of product design, not independent proof of each network's live circulating supply or liquidity. Per-chain XRPL USDC supply must be measured separately.

records.title: Circle launches Arc mainnet
records.summary: Circle says Arc mainnet launched with USDC as native gas, more than $74B USDC in circulation, a founding validator cohort including SBI Group, and Coinbase among exchange-access partners. The release says USDC represented 98.8% of agent-driven transaction volume in Circle's reported x402 activity. Morpho is named as an Arc credit-layer partner.
records.limitations: Company-reported figures and partner roles; Coinbase is an access partner, not a founding validator. SBI's Arc role is distinct from SBI/Ripple/XRPL activity. Morpho's Arc integration does not mean the Base cbXRP market is deployed on Arc. Arc's validator set is permissioned; the launch disclaimer says no NYDFS or other regulatory approval.

records.title: SBI and SMFG capital/business alliance involving SBI Startale Marketing
records.summary: Official SBI release confirms an agreement for SMFG to take a 5% capital participation in SBI Startale Marketing and to explore stablecoin-related financial services. This is a capital/business agreement, not evidence of completed production settlement volume.
records.limitations: Agreement/participation announcement does not prove funds have closed, JPYSC public-chain circulation, product revenue or XRP demand.

records.title: SBI/Startale and BlackRock memorandum on tokenized money-market fund interoperability
records.summary: Official SBI announcement describes an MOU to explore links between tokenized money-market fund products and the JPYSC ecosystem.
records.limitations: MOU is exploratory; no completed fund token, production integration, deployed capital or settlement volume is established.

records.title: SBI Ripple Asia tokenized-deposit and digital-money proof of concept
records.summary: SBI Ripple Asia announced a proof of concept using XRPL for tokenized deposits/deposit-backed digital money with partner infrastructure.
records.limitations: Proof of concept is not a commercial production deployment or a disclosed XRP treasury purchase.

records.title: SBI Ripple Asia and DSRV Japan-Korea remittance/payment research
records.summary: SBI Ripple Asia and DSRV announced research into cross-border remittance and payment use cases between Japan and Korea using XRPL-related infrastructure.
records.limitations: Research announcement does not establish production payment volume, regulatory approvals or net XRP acquisition.

records.title: SBI VC Trade RLUSD handling announcement
records.summary: SBI VC Trade announced support for Ripple USD (RLUSD), creating a direct SBI-group distribution relationship with Ripple's stablecoin.
records.limitations: Distribution/listing does not establish outstanding customer balances, XRPL-versus-Ethereum allocation or XRP spot demand.

records.title: Introducing x402: a new standard for internet-native payments
records.summary: Coinbase introduced x402 as an HTTP-native stablecoin payment protocol and explicitly named Circle among launch collaborators; Circle's product executive described USDC use cases. This creates a direct Coinbase-Circle protocol relationship.
records.limitations: Coinbase's original facilitator is not the same service as T54's XRPL facilitator. Protocol interoperability does not prove Coinbase-operated XRPL settlement.

records.title: XRPL AI infrastructure overview
records.summary: T54 describes XRPL/RLUSD tooling and states it is a Ripple-backed company building AI-native XRPL infrastructure, including RLUSD CLI and an XRPL x402 facilitator.
records.limitations: Project documentation is a primary statement of design and affiliation, not independent measurement of payment economics or token demand.

records.title: XRPL x402 facilitator documentation
records.summary: T54 documents a public x402 facilitator using payer-signed XRPL Payment transactions; the docs explicitly describe both XRP drops and issued-token amounts such as RLUSD, invoice binding and settlement verification.
records.limitations: Facilitator documentation proves supported design, not transaction value, user count, sustained adoption or XRP purchases.

records.title: XRPL surpasses 10 million x402 payments
records.summary: T54 reported more than 10 million x402 payments settled through its XRPL facilitator and a seven-day average above 500,000 payments/day as of October 1; payments can use XRP or RLUSD.
records.limitations: Vendor-reported counter; no neutral census. Transaction count is not dollar value, net capital, XRP acquisition or unique agents.

records.title: Agentic payments and x402 SourceTag semantics
records.summary: XRPL documentation explains that SourceTag is a merchant-selected endpoint identifier, not an agent identity. This prevents attributing every payment with a given tag to one payer or agent.
records.limitations: SourceTag alone cannot identify beneficial payer, agent count or transaction purpose. Use payer account, invoice binding and verified payment receipt.

records.publisher: Tokyo Small and Medium Business Investment & Consultation Co., Ltd.
records.title: Two-day generative AI and machine-learning training for investee companies
records.summary: Official Tokyo SBIC page identifies the company and a June 12-13, 2025 training for investee companies; curriculum explicitly includes ChatGPT, Copilot, AI/ML, RAG and information-leakage risk. General companies were not eligible.
records.limitations: Educational training is not an OpenAI partnership, ChatGPT investment or XRP/SBI Holdings relationship. Corrects an earlier event-date misattribution.

records.title: Ask Coin exchange profile
records.summary: CoinMarketCap's Ask Coin exchange page is marked inactive/untracked and does not provide a current verified reserve or trading-volume profile.
records.limitations: This is an exchange profile, not proof of a currently active ASK token. Exact phrase 'ASK Coin' remains ambiguous.

records.title: Permission Coin market profile
records.summary: CoinMarketCap tracks Permission Coin with ticker ASK and a Polygon contract; the token is distinct from the inactive Ask Coin exchange listing.
records.limitations: Circulating supply and volume differ from CoinGecko; low-liquidity market data are not reliable capital-flow evidence.

records.title: Permission Coin market profile
records.summary: CoinGecko tracks Permission Coin (ASK) and its Base/Polygon markets; reported circulating supply materially differs from CoinMarketCap.
records.limitations: Provider supply/volume methodology differs; do not merge or average without contract-level supply reconciliation.

records.title: Crypto Panics! with Dr. Kamilah Stevenson — The XRP Podcast
records.summary: Public interview identifies guest as Dr. Kamilah Stevenson. In the transcript she gives YouTube as 'doctor Camilla Stevenson', X as 'cam i am cam Stevenson', Instagram as 'Kamilla Stevenson', and warns about fake pages.
records.limitations: Strong identity candidate for the user's 'Camilla Stephenson' reference, but spelling differs and impersonation risk is explicitly stated. Does not establish every similarly named channel as authentic.

records.title: Dr. Kamilah Stevenson channel candidate
records.summary: Public channel handle @drkamilahstevenson is a strong candidate matching the interviewee's stated YouTube identity; third-party channel indexes report a large public catalog.
records.limitations: Channel ownership/identity link is not fully independently authenticated from a direct self-link. Full public-video inventory has not been paginated or completed.

records.title: XRP AI adoption: what 4.5 million payments really show
records.summary: A September 8 t54 dashboard snapshot showed 4,491,820 tracked payments but only 5,836.71 XRP and 4,125.29 RLUSD settled. This demonstrates why payment count cannot substitute for token value or net capital.
records.limitations: Secondary report of a vendor dashboard; historical snapshot only. Not a current total and not the entire XRPL.

records.title: AI agents emerge as dominant activity driver on XRP Ledger
records.summary: Reports t54 dashboard figures above 13.94M tracked transactions and 169 merchants around October 12, with activity concentrated in a small number of applications.
records.limitations: Vendor-attributed count; no corresponding cumulative USD value or independently audited agent identity count. Not comparable to all XRPL transactions.
